notes: Refined existing stories to address data ambiguity and test robustness; no new story IDs created per dedup rules.

change_log.value: Implement logic to parse NPI registry API response and extract board certification indicators, including handling of taxonomy codes, credential strings (e.g., MD, DO), and absence of explicit certification fields; normalize into structured certification signals.
change_log.note: Clarifies real NPI data limitations and extraction complexity

change_log.value: Implement evaluation logic to classify providers as board certified, not certified, or unknown based on extracted NPI data, including explicit handling for missing, ambiguous, or conflicting credential signals.

Create unit tests for extraction and classification logic using mocked NPI responses (including edge cases: missing credentials, multiple taxonomies, ambiguous data) and integration tests validating certification status appears correctly in EvaluateCare responses.
change_log.note: Expands test coverage to real-world edge cases

stories.title: Board Certification Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define internal data schema for board certification including fields for certification_status, board_name, specialty, certification_date, and verification_source derived from NPI registry response.

stories.title: Board Certification Extraction Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to parse NPI registry API response and extract board certification indicators, including handling of taxonomy codes, credential strings (e.g., MD, DO), and absence of explicit certification fields; normalize into structured certification signals.

stories.title: Certification Scoring and Classification
stories.description: Implement evaluation logic to classify providers as board certified, not certified, or unknown based on extracted NPI data, including explicit handling for missing, ambiguous, or conflicting credential signals.

stories.title: Evaluation API Integration
stories.description: Integrate board certification results into EvaluateCare facade response so certification status is included in provider evaluation outputs.

stories.title: Board Certification Tests and Validation
stories.description: Create unit tests for extraction and classification logic using mocked NPI responses (including edge cases: missing credentials, multiple taxonomies, ambiguous data) and integration tests validating certification status appears correctly in EvaluateCare responses.
